text: The Patriots are making moves both on and off the field as they prepare for Sunday's 1 PM ET home opener against the Steelers at Gillette Stadium, but they'll be doing so without one of their most dangerous weapons: A.J. Brown, who suffered a high ankle sprain in Week 1 and has been placed on injured reserve for a minimum of four games, leaving the offense scrambling for production at receiver. To shore up the defensive line, New England is adding free agent DT DaQuan Jones on a one-year deal worth up to $6 million, a move that signals the team is trying to maintain its defensive edge despite roster disruptions. The practice squad has seen some shuffling as well, with the team signing WR Chandler Brayboy and rookie LB Xavier Holmes while releasing S Elliott Davison and RB Hassan Haskins. Away from football matters, owner Robert Kraft made headlines for his principled stance regarding Ed Sheeran's upcoming concerts at Gillette, having Macklemore removed as an opening act due to what Kraft called "a history of antisemitic rhetoric and imagery that we believe has been deeply offensive and hurtful to the Jewish community."
